import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def did_estimator(pre_treatment, post_treatment, pre_control, post_control):
    """Calculate the Difference-in-Differences estimator."""
    diff_treated = np.mean(post_treatment) - np.mean(pre_treatment)
    diff_control = np.mean(post_control) - np.mean(pre_control)
    did = diff_treated - diff_control
    return did

def twfe_regression(data, treatment_group, post_period, outcome):
    """Estimate DiD using two-way fixed effects model."""
    n = len(outcome)
    interaction = treatment_group * post_period
    
    # Create unit fixed effects (demeaning approach)
    # Simple implementation: include interaction and controls
    features = np.column_stack([
        np.ones(n),
        treatment_group,
        post_period,
        interaction
    ])
    
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(features, outcome)
    
    # Coefficient on interaction term
    did_effect = model.coef_[3]
    return did_effect

def parallel_trends_test(pre_periods_outcome_treated, pre_periods_outcome_control):
    """Test the parallel trends assumption using pre-treatment periods."""
    n_periods = pre_periods_outcome_treated.shape[0]
    
    # Calculate differences between treated and control at each period
    diffs = pre_periods_outcome_treated - pre_periods_outcome_control
    
    # Regress differences on time trend
    time = np.arange(n_periods).reshape(-1, 1)
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(time, diffs)
    
    # If slope is close to zero, parallel trends holds
    slope = model.coef_[0]
    r_squared = model.score(time, diffs)
    
    return {'slope': slope, 'r_squared': r_squared, 'parallel_trends_plausible': abs(slope) < 0.1}

def event_study(data, treatment_group, time_periods, outcome, treatment_time):
    """Estimate dynamic treatment effects using event study."""
    n = len(outcome)
    relative_time = time_periods - treatment_time
    
    # Create leads and lags
    periods = np.unique(relative_time)
    periods = periods[periods != -1]  # Omit period just before treatment
    
    effects = {}
    for p in periods:
        indicator = (relative_time == p).astype(int) * treatment_group
        features = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), indicator])
        model = LinearRegression()
        model.fit(features, outcome)
        effects[f'period_{p}'] = model.coef_[1]
    
    return effects

if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 200
    
    # Simulated data
    pre_treated = np.random.normal(10, 2, n//2)
    post_treated = np.random.normal(13, 2, n//2)  # Treatment effect of 3
    pre_control = np.random.normal(10, 2, n//2)
    post_control = np.random.normal(10.5, 2, n//2)
    
    did = did_estimator(pre_treated, post_treated, pre_control, post_control)
    print(f"DiD estimate: {did:.3f}")
    
    # Parallel trends test
    pre_trends_treated = np.array([10.0, 10.1, 10.2])
    pre_trends_control = np.array([10.0, 10.1, 10.2])
    pt = parallel_trends_test(pre_trends_treated, pre_trends_control)
    print(f"Parallel trends test: {pt}")
